verdict.rationale: LiveKit lets you deploy agents that run on LiveKit Cloud without managing servers, keep them always-on, and route inbound calls to them through dispatch rules. Auto-egress also starts recording automatically when a room is created. These are event-triggered background behaviors, but they are real-time session agents rather than general user-defined automations, and nothing shows scheduled or recurring jobs. missing for 10: user-configurable background automation or workflow definitions, scheduled or recurring triggers, trigger types beyond rooms and calls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Deploy and run agents directly on LiveKit Cloud without managing servers or orchestration.
Keep agents always-on for instant responses
It starts recording automatically when a room is created.
All callers can be placed in the same room or different rooms based on the dispatch rules.
